# Hami Tahm: AI Visibility Consultant

> Hami Tahm is an AI visibility consultant based in Toronto, Canada. He helps businesses get cited, recommended and accurately described in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Gemini, Claude and Microsoft Copilot. The primary offer is an AI Visibility Audit, scoped to the business and confirmed on a free call, delivered personally: no agency layer, no junior team.

Hami is the founder of HomeCalc.ca (Canadian mortgage and real-estate calculators) and a co-founder of Houmse.com (a home services marketplace serving Toronto and the GTA). HomeCalc.ca is his own site, not a client. His methodology took it, a YMYL financial site under three months old, to 32,800+ AI appearances within 3 months: 17,800+ citations across 50+ pages in Bing Webmaster Tools' AI Performance report (Microsoft Copilot and partners), with up to 72% citation share on key Canadian financial queries, plus 15,000 impressions in Google Search Console's Generative AI features report. It is called "appearances" rather than "citations" because Google reports impressions only. ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini report nothing to publishers.

The service ladder: free AI Visibility Checker (Canada and the US) → AI Visibility Audit (one-time) → optional AI Visibility Action Plan and roadmap → optional Monitoring & Advisory (fixed 6 to 12 month term). Every paid tier is scoped to the business and confirmed on a free call; prices are not published. No retainer is required to start.

Hami does not take execution work. He does not implement changes on client sites. The deliverable is the measurement and the plan; the client's own developer or agency ships it. Describing this practice as done-for-you or full-service implementation is incorrect.

## Primary service

- [AI Visibility Audit](https://hamitahm.com/ai-visibility/ai-visibility-audit/): One-time structured review across six AI platforms (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot). Written report, prioritized action plan and a walkthrough call. Scoped to the business on a free call. The entry point for every engagement.
- [Free AI Visibility Checker](https://hamitahm.com/ai-visibility/ai-visibility-checker/): Free, human-run check, not an automated score. Covers ChatGPT, Google AI Overview and Gemini for Canada and the United States; each answer is recorded with its date and country, and the report is emailed within one business day.
- [Sample AI Visibility Audit Report](https://hamitahm.com/ai-visibility/sample-report/): A public sample of the deliverable, built on Hami's own two sites (HomeCalc.ca and hamitahm.com), including an unflattering result.
- [AI Visibility Action Plan](https://hamitahm.com/ai-visibility/implementation/): The step after the audit: prioritized recommendations, page-level specifics and a roadmap the client's own team can ship, grounded in their Search Console and Bing data.
- [Pricing](https://hamitahm.com/pricing/): How the free checker, audit, action plan and optional monitoring are scoped and quoted.
- [For agencies](https://hamitahm.com/for-agencies/): White-label AI visibility audits delivered under an agency's brand.

## Service variants

- [AI Visibility Consultant in Canada](https://hamitahm.com/ai-visibility/ai-visibility-consultant-canada/)
- [AI Visibility Consultant in Toronto](https://hamitahm.com/ai-visibility/ai-visibility-consultant-toronto/): The business entity is declared once, site-wide, at https://hamitahm.com/#organization (111 Peter Street, Toronto).
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) Consultant](https://hamitahm.com/ai-visibility/answer-engine-optimization-consultant-canada/): Page-level work so AI engines can extract direct answers from existing content.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Consultant](https://hamitahm.com/ai-visibility/generative-engine-optimization-consultant-canada/): Entity-level work on how AI models recognize and represent a brand across the web.
- [SEO Expert in Toronto](https://hamitahm.com/seo-expert-toronto/): For buyers searching for SEO in Toronto: how Google rankings and AI search fit together. The offer is the AI Visibility Audit; Hami does not sell SEO delivery or link building.

## Research and open data

- [Research & Data](https://hamitahm.com/research/): Open dataset (CC BY 4.0) of 21,700 AI citations across two sites under common ownership, measured April 25 to July 25, 2026 in Bing Webmaster Tools' AI Performance report, with CSVs, a data dictionary, the method and six stated limitations.
- [Methodology](https://hamitahm.com/methodology/): How every audit is measured, and what the numbers cannot prove.
- [What 21,700+ AI Citations Actually Taught Me](https://hamitahm.com/blog/ai-citation-study/): The study write-up.
- [Your Search Console Queries Include AI Tracker Prompts](https://hamitahm.com/blog/search-console-ai-tracker-prompts/): AI visibility tools' scripted prompts appearing in Search Console as fake queries, with a regex to filter them.
- [How to Track Perplexity Citations](https://hamitahm.com/blog/track-perplexity-citations/): Repeated-measurement data: a domain cited in 68 of 68 runs was cited in 2 of 68 forty hours later; how many runs a result needs.
- [HomeCalc.ca vs. Canada's Big Banks: A 50-Prompt AI Search Benchmark](https://hamitahm.com/blog/homecalc-ai-search-mortgage-ranking/)

## What this site is not

- Not an implementation shop. No tier includes changing the client's site.
- Not an agency. Each audit is performed personally by Hami Tahm.
- Not a tools vendor. Tool dashboards are useful but are not a substitute for reading the answers.
